part.text: {"items":[{"index":1,"kind":"reframe","meets_criterion":"yes","quote":"Change the unit of work from chain steps to independent simulator runs: amortized simulation-based inference.","reason":"Replaces serial MCMC chain iterations with independent simulator runs batched simultaneously on GPUs; extra compute now cuts posterior error, not correlated samples."},{"index":2,"kind":"reframe","meets_criterion":"no","quote":"Change what is measured: target the decision quantity directly — e.g., the posterior of the 1%-exceedance (100-year) flood quantile — by emulating the map from parameters to that quantity with a Gaussian process, choosing evaluation points actively.","reason":"Changes the measured quantity and concentrates evaluations on the tail; no chain, time-step, or solver iteration dependency is removed or parallelized."},{"index":3,"kind":"reframe","meets_criterion":"yes","quote":"Cut and reorder the unit of work: decompose the record into near-independent hydrologic events (with short warm-ups) plus recession blocks, calibrate each block in parallel, and combine the block posteriors (consensus Bayes).","reason":"Breaks the decades-long timestep recursion into independent event and recession blocks calibrated simultaneously; the serial time dependency within each likelihood evaluation is removed."}]}
